## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who is affected and why does the current
behavior fall short?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature as concretely as you can: behavior, surface (CLI,
API, WebSocket, WebUI), and how it fits the existing architecture.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why you prefer this one.

## Additional context

Relevant docs, links, or examples. New features follow the process in
`docs/specs/` and `docs/plans/` — link any related design discussion if
you have one.
